texts.title_text: U.S., Russia, and Ukraine held first direct peace talks in over nine months in Abu Dhabi
texts.slide_1_text: Russia struck energy infrastructure hours before talks, causing blackouts in six regions and killing two in Ladyzhyn
texts.slide_2_text: U.S. pressure on Kyiv to accept territorial concessions favorable to Moscow raised concerns ahead of the talks
texts.slide_3_text: Russian deputy foreign minister Sergei Ryabkov called it too early to assess progress, though talks continue Wednesday
texts.slide_4_text: Ukraine's president called discussions 'constructive and substantive,' focusing on prisoner releases and security guarantees
texts.slide_5_text: European leaders fear U.S. may prioritize bilateral deals over NATO-backed security framework
